Como welcome Venezia to Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia on 1 November 2026 for a Serie A fixture scheduled to kick off at 11:30 UTC. The match falls in the early phase of the 2026-27 Italian top-flight season, with both sides having played nine league matches so far.

Como sit fifth in the table with 20 points from nine games, recording six wins, two draws and one defeat. Their form sequence reads WWWDL, underlining a strong start that has them in contention for European places. Venezia, by contrast, are rooted to the bottom of the standings with just three points from nine outings — one win and eight losses — and a form line of LLWLL.

The fixture pits the division's fifth-best attack (17 goals scored) against its leakiest defence (19 goals conceded). Como have also been solid at the back, shipping only eight goals, while Venezia have managed a mere six goals all season. The gulf in current form and table position makes this a mismatch on paper, though head-to-head history shows recent meetings have been closely contested.
